answer: The door takes payment, not promises: the farm pays 73944 POA while one agent pays 158. Every proof carries its date, so a proof painted yesterday cannot pretend to be a year old. Curing a proof takes 2 days, and a farm holding 468 proofs cannot cure them side by side. A hundred masks, one question: can the applicant show each steel is a dated polishing log kept by the shop steward under Rim solderer steel warrant mounted on the spectacle case? An applicant who owns a tide, owes a gale and outlasted a hollow is an agent; an applicant holding only the first two is a farm in a hurry.
